description: The runs of one dataset, newest first: each with its state (QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, PARTIAL, FAILED, CANCELLED…), when it finished, how many rows it collected, the pages it read and the credits it cost, and, when it did not go well, the problem in words. "incomplete" says where a run stopped at a limit: its rows are then not the whole list. Use it after run_monitor to know when the run has finished; then get_dataset_rows reads its rows.
name: get_dataset_runs
title: List a dataset's runs
